notes.title: Tomorrow’s Land – UI & Graphics Update + New Auto Mode
notes.content:
[h3]🚀 Tomorrow’s Land – New Update Released![/h3][p align="start"]🔹 [b]UI Update[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved user interface, now more intuitive and easier to use.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]🔹 [b]Graphics Update[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enhanced graphics with smoother and sharper visual effects.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]🔹 [b]New Feature: Auto Mode[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]Auto Mode[/b] (press [b]J[/b]) to support a more comfortable gameplay experience.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Thank you all for supporting [i]Tomorrow’s Land[/i]! ❤️
Please keep sharing your feedback so we can make the game even better in future updates.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258297/95299e7e03a56ebb598d9cd6abf4a3ac1b46f859.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: ✨ New Update Available! ✨
notes.content:
[p align="start"]✨ [b]New Update Available![/b] ✨[/p][p align="start"]🎨 [b]UI Update[/b][/p][list][*][p]Refreshed and improved User Interface for a smoother and modern look.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]🐞 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a critical crash issue that caused the game to unexpectedly close.[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor stability improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]🛠️ [b]New Commands[/b]
You can now teleport quickly between islands using the chat command:[/p][p][/p][p]/fly @adminisland1[/p][p]/fly @adminisland2[/p][p]/fly @adminisland3[/p][p]/fly @adminisland4[/p][p]/fly @adminisland5[/p][p]/fly @adminisland6[/p][p]/fly @adminisland7[/p][p]/fly @adminisland8[/p][p]/fly @adminisland9[/p][p]/fly @adminisland10[/p][p]/fly @adminisland11[/p][p]/fly @adminisland12[/p][p]/fly @adminisland13[/p][p][/p][p]👉 See more at our Page: [url="https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100089308366667&utm_source=chatgpt.com"]Tomorrow’s Land Official[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258297/d6e8f13f93e0281cad2bacd4d37e14a5317095ea.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]
